title: Early Adopter Onboarding & Release Signal Contract for Lighthouse Cohort
creator: Priya Nair
description: Goal: Define a lightweight, enforceable "release signal contract" and onboarding checklist to get 6 lighthouse/early-adopter customers live with the new hosted API feature set, and to coordinate release notes and GTM comms so we have predictable, auditable go/no-go decisions. This ticket formalizes required signals (quality, reliability, docs, support readiness), the feedback cadence for the cohort, and the owner matrix for release notes and post-launch action items.
acceptance_criteria: Three independent quality signals green for 72h before wide beta: automated eval pass rate >= 92% on the agreed prompt suite; regression false positive rate < 2%; end-to-end smoke tests passing across 3 test accounts
Latency SLO: p95 inference latency <= 140ms for hosted tier under lighthouse traffic profile (measured across 2 regions), with continued monitoring dashboard in Console
Reliability SLO: error rate (5xx + infra timeouts) < 0.5% for 72h under pilot traffic
Documentation & release notes published: PRD and public-facing release notes live in Drive and GitHub respectively; release notes have owner and review signoff from legal where required
Support & SRE readiness: on-call rotation & runbook published; triage SLA for lighthouse bugs <= 48 hours
At least 4 of 6 lighthouse customers complete onboarding checklist items and provide initial feedback score >= 7 (1-10)
rollout_milestones: Week 0 (Prep): finalize PRD + onboarding checklist, share to #lighthouse-onboarding channel
Week 1 (Onboard): run hands-on onboarding with first 2 accounts, record session and update onboarding doc
Week 2 (Pilot Validation): collect telemetry, run full smoke tests, and capture qualitative notes from each account
Week 3 (Signal Window): require 72h green window for all automated signals before expanding cohort
Post-launch Week 1: weekly bug triage with engineering, PM, and support; gather customer satisfaction survey
feedback_process: Weekly 30-min sync with lighthouse account POCs — agenda: blockers, feature requests, platform telemetry highlights
Dedicated Slack channel (#lighthouse-51328) for rapid feedback; engineering triage label 'L-HOUSE' for bugs from cohort
Structured post-onboarding survey (Google Form) sent at day 7 and day 21; results must be consolidated into a short report
Feedback triage policy: critical issues (P0/P1) escalate to SRE lead and PM within 4 hours; P2 resolved within 48 hours
